reports.notes: Handwritten, crisp. Lines 3 and 7 are the filer's SLASHED-zero glyph, transcribed as 0 at medium confidence; cents on several rows are superscripted and underlined. THE STREET ADDRESS CELL IS EMPTY on the published page (faint residue where text was) while City/State/Zip survive - consistent with upstream redaction by the county; nothing is reconstructed. THE FILER ADDED AN UNPROMPTED ANNOTATION in the margin below line 7, carried verbatim in totals_verbatim as filer_annotation_below_line7: '( LOAN TO SELF FOR NON CONTRIBUTION COVERED CAMPAIGN EXPENSES.' - the word read as COVERED is the one ambiguous word (it could be read GOVERED/GOVERNED from the glyphs), hence medium confidence; the opening parenthesis is unclosed as printed. It appears to explain that the reported money is a self-loan, not third-party contributions. Office Seeking reads simply 'Sheriff'; index.csv says 'County Sheriff' - same office. Page/of on the summary page reads 1 of 1.

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (4,574.30) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4,574.30) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (4,574.30), and is corroborated by summary line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' = 4,574.30
contributions.detail: 4 Schedule A rows sum to 500.00 + 36.00 + 150.00 + 3888.30 = 4,574.30 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's PROMOTED PER-PERIOD cell (Column A). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 4,574.30 (this is the filer's first report of the 2010 cycle, so cycle-to-date genuinely equals this period) and is NOT summed as an increment. THE LOAN QUESTION IS DECIDED BY THE ARITHMETIC: row 4 is the candidate's own $3,888.30 'LOAN TO SELF' written onto the CONTRIBUTION ledger, and the schedule's own subtotal INCLUDES it (500+36+150 alone is 686.00, which matches nothing). So on this filing the loan IS an itemized contribution row — the opposite of the Witney 2010 specimen in ADDENDUM A A4, where the cover's ladder proved the loan was the beginning balance. Same county, same cycle, two filers, two treatments; each is settled only by that filing's own arithmetic.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (4,574.30) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (4,574.30) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' (4,574.30), and corroborated by summary line 6 'Total Expenditures Made (From Line 2 Column A)' = 4,574.30
expenditures.detail: 16 Schedule B rows sum to 544.31 + 127.25 + 7.65 + 55.99 + 191.62 + 1478.91 + 118.19 + 105.68 + 157.99 + 1163.08 + 21.34 + 341.60 + 24.69 + 50.00 + 36.00 + 150.00 = 4,574.30 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A. Column B YTD also prints 4,574.30 (first report of the cycle) and is never summed as an increment. Note the coincidence that BOTH sides total 4,574.30: it is not a transcription artefact — the two ledgers are independently itemized and independently sum to that figure, and the filer's own balance ladder closes at line 7 = 0 (slashed-zero glyph) because he spent exactly what he raised, having loaned himself the shortfall.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither schedule prints an in-kind column and no row is marked in-kind. BOTH conventions were tested as required: monetary-only gives 4,574.30 on each side and monetary-plus-in-kind gives the same 4,574.30 (there is no in-kind amount to add), so both close and the distinction does not arise on this filing.
itemized.escalation_note: Three tight 900-dpi cell crops, all confirmatory rather than corrective: (a) the p3 band-1 CONTROL crop required by ADDENDUM A A1 — see the p3 measure_note; (b) the p3 row-4 amount, first cropped at the amount column's own 84.77-95.07 band which clipped the raised cents, then re-cropped one column wider at pct:83.5,27.33,15.5,4.07@p3 which rendered '3,888.' with a raised '30' — 3,888.30 confirmed; (c) the p4 row-16 amount, which rendered '150.' with a raised '00'. No glyph was ever in dispute against the arithmetic; every escalation resolved legibility only.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'James O. Tracy Jr.', Republican, residence city Provo, Office Seeking 'Sheriff' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 county_static listing grouped filings by office), so the page face is the only identity and it should be promoted through office_overrides.csv by the coordinator (the Ainge precedent). This is the first of THREE 2010 filings by this filer in the chunk (061510 primary, 102610 general, 110910R). legacy_colAB variant; 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES', type 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', amendment box ticked No, signed and dated 06-15-2010, clerk stamp 'JUN 15 PM12:35'), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' heading, not by ordinal), p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. The form's own foliation boxes are filled '1 of 1' on all three inner pages — the filer numbered each sheet as its own document, so the box is no guide to page order (companion to ADDENDUM A A4's Poulson foliation property). Cover lines 3 and 7 (balance at beginning / at close) are the filer's SLASHED-ZERO glyph and read 0 under the zero-glyph ruling; both sides of this report therefore close a zero-to-zero period. TWO CROSS-SCHEDULE MIRRORS: Action Target 36.00 (4/20/10) and Off Duty Web LLC 150.00 (05/03/10) each appear on BOTH Schedule A and Schedule B, and both schedules' own printed subtotals include them, so both are retained on both sides exactly as filed. Nothing was differenced across covers and no figure was nudged.
